reviews.body:
### 🟢 Approval recommended No active review issues were identified for the change enforcing mandatory end-date filtering. **No open issues** 🎉
What changed in this PR This PR addresses #511 by making the SentinelOne collector always skip expectations without an end-date signature, removing the user-controlled bypass that could cause false negatives. **Changes:** - Enforces end-date filtering regardless of the former disable flag. - Removes the option from settings, daemon configuration, and Docker Compose. - Adds a regression test confirming the legacy flag cannot bypass filtering. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | `sentinelone/​tests/​unit/​services/​test_expectation_service.py` | Updates initialization assertions and tests mandatory end-date filtering. | | `sentinelone/​src/​services/​expectation_service.py` | Always checks for an end date before batching expectations. | | `sentinelone/​src/​models/​configs/​sentinelone_configs.py` | Removes the disable-strict-end-date setting. | | `sentinelone/​src/​models/​configs/​config_loader.py` | Removes the option from daemon configuration output. | | `sentinelone/​docker-compose.yml` | Removes the legacy environment variable passthrough. |
Review effort: Balanced
